places.name: Truckhenge
places.description: These elevated trucks were put in place as a middle finger to The Man, but are now considered folk art.

places.name: Equality House
places.description: A rainbow-colored house promotes LGBTQ rights across the street from the Westboro Baptist Church.

places.name: Kansas State Capitol Cupola

places.description: A mysterious local has been dressing the child's grave for decades.

places.name: Huntoon Park Wren
